name: RehAnalytics — By Rehani
author: khuzaplugins

sections.description:
See how a listing’s asking price compares to the market.

Khuza RehAnalytics adds a compact valuation widget to single property listing pages on your WordPress site. It compares the asking price to a machine-learning price estimate and shows a simple Under / Fair / Over gauge, so buyers can judge value at a glance.

Connect your site once from Settings → Khuza RehAnalytics, then the widget appears automatically on supported single listing pages.

Why site owners install it

  • Build buyer trust — an independent price signal next to each listing.
  • Keeps buyers on your page — the estimate loads inline, no redirect.
  • Get Mortgage handoff — when the Khuza Get Mortgage plugin is active, its button appears inside the widget.
  • Free to install — no setup cost.
  • Works with your theme — drops into standard property listing layouts.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and connect your site to your Khuza account.
  2. On a single property listing page, the plugin reads the listing details (price, location, beds, baths, size, type).
  3. It requests an ML estimate from Rehani Soko and renders the Under / Fair / Over gauge.
  4. A link to the full valuation report opens on Rehani Soko.

Coverage

  • Single property listing pages only (not grid cards).
  • Kenya and Tanzania listings (v1).
  • Tested with Houzez; designed for WP Residence, Estatik, and Real Homes.

Requirements:

  • A Rehani Soko / Khuza account (register at rehanisoko.com)
  • A real estate theme with single property listing pages
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services operated by Rehani Soko.

Rehani Soko API

  • Service: https://render-prod.rehanisoko-internal.com/api/v1
  • Used for: connecting your WordPress site, fetching widget configuration, and requesting the ML price estimate for a listing.
  • Data sent: your site URL, connection token/API key, plugin version, and listing metadata (title, price, currency, location, beds, baths, size, property type, page URL).
  • When: on plugin connect/disconnect, config refresh, and when the widget loads on a single listing page.
  • Terms of service: https://www.rehanisoko.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://www.rehanisoko.com/privacy-policy

Rehani Soko website

  • Service: https://www.rehanisoko.com
  • Used for: opening the full valuation report in the buyer’s browser.
  • Data sent: the listing ID from the API call above.
  • When: when a visitor clicks “Full valuation report”.
  • Terms of service: https://www.rehanisoko.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://www.rehanisoko.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload, or install from the directory.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Settings > Khuza RehAnalytics and paste your connection token from your Khuza dashboard.
  4. Save. The widget appears on supported single listing pages.

To get a token: log in at platform.rehanisoko.com → Dashboard → Plugins → WordPress → Khuza RehAnalytics → Generate Connection Token.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything to install?

No. Installation and setup are free.

Do I need a Rehani Soko account?

Yes. Sign up at rehanisoko.com and generate a connection token from the Khuza dashboard.

Where does the widget appear?

On single property listing pages in supported countries. It does not appear on grid/archive cards or generic WordPress Pages.

Which markets does it support?

Kenya and Tanzania in v1. The widget only renders for listings in supported countries.

Which themes does it work with?

Tested with Houzez. Designed for WP Residence, Estatik, and Real Homes. Contact support if your listing layout needs a custom hook.

Does this plugin store buyer data?

No. WordPress only stores your site connection credentials. Listing metadata is sent to Rehani Soko to compute the estimate; the full report is served on Rehani Soko.

How accurate is the estimate?

It is a machine-learning estimate based on comparable sales. When there are too few nearby comparables, the widget shows “No reliable estimate yet” instead of a number.
